questions.q: What is Professor X's primary mutant power?
questions.why: Xavier is one of the world's most powerful telepaths, able to read and control minds.

questions.q: Who played the older Professor X in the X-Men films beginning in 2000?
questions.why: Patrick Stewart played the older Xavier, with James McAvoy playing him in the younger prequel era.

questions.q: What device does Professor X use to detect and locate mutants?
questions.why: Xavier designed Cerebro to amplify his mind and find people carrying the mutant gene.

questions.q: Which hero was a member of the original X-Men and codenamed Marvel Girl?
questions.why: Jean Grey, the only girl in the first X-Men lineup, took the name Marvel Girl.

questions.q: In which county of New York is Xavier's School for Gifted Youngsters located, in Salem Center?
questions.why: The school and X-Mansion sit in Salem Center, which is in Westchester County, New York.

questions.q: Professor X's son David Haller grows up to become which mutant?
questions.why: David, the child of Charles and Gabrielle Haller, became the powerful and unstable mutant Legion.

questions.q: Who co-created Professor X with artist Jack Kirby?
questions.why: Stan Lee wrote The X-Men #1 and created Xavier with Kirby in 1963.

questions.q: In his original comics backstory, which alien scout dropped a stone block that paralyzed Xavier's legs?
questions.why: Lucifer dropped a block of stone on Xavier near the Himalayas, which paralysed him.

questions.q: In which city did Charles Xavier and Erik Lehnsherr first meet in the comics?
questions.why: Xavier and Magneto met in Haifa, Israel, and became friends before their ideals pulled them apart.

questions.q: Xavier formed a psychic bond with which alien princess, later becoming her consort?
questions.why: Lilandra of the Shi'ar empire fell for Xavier and he later became her consort.
